action_review.review_scope: Official tag-to-commit binding, signature verification status and action inputs, checkout credential cleanup and artifact file selection/upload source. No full transitive source audit claimed.

upstream_review.scope: Dated official upstream recheck; retained version and no exploit execution.

qualifications: Actual Windows 11 desktop automation and hosted Windows Server CI are distinct; no Linux substitute or owner gesture evidence.
T001-T004 remain legacy characterization; T007 is the separate real assertion control. Mandatory corrected coverage T005-T066 excluding T007 has no skipped tests.
All ten advertised extensions have executed real codec tests; unavailable-reader controls use masked capability replies plus real supported sibling conversion and video copying.
Actual UNC target remains not_run; lexical root and local long-path tests do not establish network-share support.
Scoped analyzer excludes Pester DSL bodies, historical tools and vendor code. Diagnostics alone do not prove filesystem or API compatibility.
First full desktop runs were superseded during review; source/commit checks reject them. Their retained observations are not acceptance evidence.

Implementation5a25be5 hosted all459 assertions passed per normal job but its string-only suite container check rejected every FileInfo container. Both push/PR matrices remain failed; the final helper and actual-container regression repair this without weakening suite/case/codec/skip gates.
Checksum review binds package bytes; no Authenticode/publisher-identity claim, exploit sample execution, persistent policy change or runtime dependency install.
Final containing evidence checkpoint synchronization is pending independent post-commit observation. M3-T07 owner approval, merge and release remain separate.

case_results.finding: Both actual Windows desktop shells and four hosted Windows jobs executed all 23 mandatory suites, 61 corrected case IDs and 468 tests with zero skips/unrun/inconclusive/infrastructure failures and native exit0. Each exact assertion control had469 total/468 passed/one intended T007 failure/native1. Empty/skipped/missing/inventory/container/source negative gates and actual typed Pester container regressions passed.

Ten real extension outcomes passed: jpg/jpeg/png/bmp/tif/tiff/gif/webp/heic/heif. HEIC/HEIF positives are the real T031 collections. All ten controlled missing-reader cases completed actual supported siblings and preserved videos; missing JPEG writer failed setup. Capability/source/dependency/OS/host metadata is recorded with no mandatory codec skip. Support is limited to the verified pinned ImageMagick7.1.2-32 build.

Verified analyzer1.25.0/pinned extraction,15 reviewed rules and seven maintained scripts passed with zero findings in both desktop shells and all hosted jobs; each unsafe-expression text control produced exactly one intended finding/native1. Workflow negative checks passed, actual CI permissions were read-only, action pins/source were reviewed and credentials were not persisted. Downloaded two-file artifacts passed digest, source and scalar allowlist/privacy checks; final UTC fractions are preserved. Analyzer and workflow audits retain their declared scope.
